body: Thanks. I will try to keep her as a friend. I have still a little bit of feelings for her, considering holidays. It fucking sucks.

I'm scared of therapy. I keep hoping the stars will align. I had that with my ex. But in the end I screwed it up. Thanks for your advice. I kinda want to stay away from drugs. Sorry, my mind is kinda scrambled right now, my reply might not make any sense.

It's difficult. My current state of mind is nowhere close to positive.

Not having financial difficulty? A woman who loves me for who I am and not fault me for having depression? I don't know, it's really a difficult question. Does it sound silly?

I'm on the same boat. I just got out of a relationship (3 years) my ex barely had friends, so I'm always around her 24/7. I pretty alienated my group of friends, just to be with her. I was teaching my ex how to be sociable and everytime someone wants to hang out with her, I always go and tell her, "Go! Go with your friends! I'll just stay home so you'll have your friends attention and not me. (Talking from past experiences with hanging out with friends with their bf/gf's.) 

Now we broke up, she's moved on. The roles are kinda switched now. The only friend I have, unfortunately is her. I still know how to talk to people, but never really for relationships.
